value.rationale: The natural joint problem requires simultaneous frame synchronization and detection of any single symbol substitution. An unconstrained size-17 benchmark does not quantify this tradeoff; exact size nine and all 24 equality configurations, reduced to two inequivalent geometries, provide a complete design baseline. These are not an arbitrary slice or a mere re-tabulation of unconstrained maxima; their Hamming-distance restriction is motivated by channel robustness. No generalized theorem is asserted.
